text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: A sea beast that multiplies and swims through the sky. A white whale whose shape has been twisted by acquiring factors from another world. Those who challenge it are those who wish to protect the fun summer ahead of them.
text_block_list.orig_text:
増殖し、空を泳ぐ海の獣。
異世界の因子を得てカタチの捻じ曲がったシロクジラ。
それに挑むのは、楽しい夏を守りたいと願う者たちであった。

text_block_list.name: White whale
text_block_list.text: ...GUOOOH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Beach Guest 1
text_block_list.text: Wh-What's that?! A whale... is it...?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
なっ、
なにあれ！？
クジラ、
なの……！？

text_block_list.name: Beach Guest 2
text_block_list.text: I've never seen a flying whale before! And... just how many are there?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
空飛ぶクジラなんて見たことねぇぞ！
それに、
何頭いやがんだ！？

text_block_list.name: Beach Guest 3
text_block_list.text: It's as if the heavens and the earth have been turned upside down... W-We have to run away! Dear...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
天と地が、ひっくり返ったみたい……
に、
逃げないと！　
あなた……！

text_block_list.name: Rem
text_block_list.text: I knew it, with such a huge body, there's no way it wouldn't cause chaos around us...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
やはりこれだけの巨体、
周囲の混乱は避けられませんね……！

text_block_list.name: Kokkoro
text_block_list.text: As for us, I don't think we really have a plan on how to tackle them on.
text_block_list.orig_text:
こちらとしても、
どう攻めていいのか
悩ましいところでございます。

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: It's not fair that they can fly into the sky with such a big build! And they're multiplying too somehow! This is truly a nightmare...
text_block_list.orig_text:
あんな図体しといて
空まで飛んでるなんてズルでしょ！
しかもなんか増えてるし！　
悪夢よこんなの～……

text_block_list.name: Ram
text_block_list.text: Face reality, Kyaru. If you believe that this is a nightmare, I'm ready to pinch your cheek.
text_block_list.orig_text:
現実を見なさい、
キャル。
悪夢だと思っているなら頬をつねってあげてもいいけど。

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: Owowowow... Hey, wait! You're already pinching me!
text_block_list.orig_text:
いたたたっ……
って、
もうつねってるじゃない！

text_block_list.name: White whale
text_block_list.text: ...GUOOOH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Rem
text_block_list.text: The while whales are sending out the small monsters now...! Please be careful!
text_block_list.orig_text:
シロクジラから小型の魔物が……！
気を付けてください！

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: If we end up touching one of those we'll go all 'babuu♪' or 'ogyaa♪'... This isn't a joke anymore.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あれに触れると
「ばぶー♪」とか
「おぎゃー♪」とか
する羽目になるのよね……
冗談じゃないっての。

text_block_list.name: Ram
text_block_list.text: Surprisingly, I agree. But their individual strength is no threat. Kyaru, step forward.
text_block_list.orig_text:
珍しく同感ね。
でも一匹一匹の強さは脅威ではないわ。
キャル、
前に出なさい。

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: AND WHAT ABOUT MY SAFETY?! Besides, your instructions are sloppy, Ram! Just telling me to step forward is...
text_block_list.orig_text:
あたしの身の安全は！？
それに
あんたは指示が雑なのよ、ラム！
前に出ろったって──

text_block_list.name: Rem
text_block_list.text: Understood, Nee-sama. Lady Kyaru, Rem will surround those monsters with ice as you attract them.
text_block_list.orig_text:
分かりました姉様。
キャル様が魔物を惹き付けている間に
レムが氷で包囲します。

text_block_list.name: Kokkoro
text_block_list.text: Well then as for me, I will match together with Lady Rem's magic.
text_block_list.orig_text:
それではわたくしは
レムさまの氷魔法に合わせます。

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: Huh? What? Is it me? Am I just bad at listening? No, it's that pampering duo that's weird, isn't it? Hey, Ram, what's with that look?! It pisses me off how proud you are!
text_block_list.orig_text:
えっなに？　
あたし？　
あたしの察しが悪いの？
いや、
あの甘やかしコンビがおかしいのよね？
ちょっとラム、
何よその目は！　
やたら自慢気なのがむかつく！

text_block_list.name: Pecorine
text_block_list.text: ...Things are looking bad.
text_block_list.orig_text: ──まずいですね。

text_block_list.name: Emilia
text_block_list.text: ...That's right. On our own we could probably do something about all this, but...
text_block_list.orig_text:
……そうね。
私たちのことだけなら何とかできそうだけど──

text_block_list.name: Beach Guest 1
text_block_list.text: H-HELP MEEEEEEEEEEEEEE!
text_block_list.orig_text:
たっ、
助け
てーっ！

text_block_list.name: Beach Guest 2
text_block_list.text: *giggle*♪
text_block_list.orig_text: きゃっきゃっ♪

text_block_list.name: Beach Guest 3
text_block_list.text: What's wrong with you, dear?! I-Is it because those monsters got you...?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
どうしたのあなた！？
あ、
あの魔物にやられたから……！？

text_block_list.name: Pecorine
text_block_list.text: The people who weren't able to escape in time are starting to get hurt. Now that it's come to this, we can't tally any longer...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
逃げ遅れた人たちに被害が出始めています。
ああなってしまうと、
もう逃げることもできません……！

text_block_list.name: Pecorine
text_block_list.text: Oh I know, Puck! Can't you defeat those little monsters all at once?
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうだパックさん！
あの小さな魔物を一気に倒せたりしませんかっ？

text_block_list.name: Puck
text_block_list.text: Hmm, I believe that's a little difficult. I probably can defeat them all in one fell swoop, but that'd also end up hitting the people who're currently sitting around aimlessly due to their memories being stolen.
text_block_list.orig_text:
うーん、
ちょっと難しいかな。
一気に倒すこと自体はできるんだけど、
記憶を奪われて
逃げられない人たちにも当たっちゃう。

text_block_list.name: Emilia
text_block_list.text: That's definitely a "no", then. However we really need to find a way to get rid of those small monsters.
text_block_list.orig_text:
それは絶対ダメね。
やっぱり、
私たちで小型の魔物を減らさないと。

text_block_list.name: Pecorine
text_block_list.text: Yes... Of course we have to defeat the small monsters, but if we don't defeat the white whales too, then those little monsters will just keep increasing.
text_block_list.orig_text:
はい……
小型の魔物を倒すのはもちろんなんですが、
シロクジラも倒さないと、
魔物が増え続けるだけなんですよね。

text_block_list.name: Pecorine
text_block_list.text: We're at a stalemate...!
text_block_list.orig_text: これは本格的に……！

text_block_list.name: Emilia
text_block_list.text: And a really difficult one at that...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
すごーく大変、
ね……！

text_block_list.name: Subaru
text_block_list.text: ...Indeed.
text_block_list.orig_text: ──そうだ。

text_block_list.name: Subaru
text_block_list.text: Before, this is where "The End" would take place.
text_block_list.orig_text: 前は『ここで終わり』だった。

text_block_list.name: Subaru
text_block_list.text: Those dastardly whales overwhelming mass, mobility, and even their numbers were growing. Emilia, Pecorine, and the others are forced to fight while protecting the affected people, and as a result end up being unable to fight back as they would have liked.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あのクジラ野郎の圧倒的な質量、
機動力、
しかも数まで増えるときてる。
エミリアやペコリーヌたちは
人々を守りながらの戦いを強いられ、
思うように反撃ができなかった。

text_block_list.name: Subaru
text_block_list.text: In a situation where I was forced to defend myself, my memories suddenly returned - among the small monsters born from the white whale, there was one that bore my memories, and by chance I was able to defeat it during the battle.
text_block_list.orig_text:
防戦を強いられる状況で、
突如として戻った俺の記憶──
シロクジラから生み出される小さな魔物の中に
俺の記憶を持った個体がいて、
戦いの中で偶然それを撃破できたんだ。

text_block_list.name: Subaru
text_block_list.text: But... that was as far as I went last time. Right after my memories came back, that damn whale came towards me and...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
でも──
前回はそこまでだった。
記憶が戻った直後、
俺はあの、シロクジラに──ッ！

text_block_list.name: Subaru
text_block_list.text: ...But thanks to that, I was able to start over with my memories. It's all thanks to everyone who didn't give up and kept fighting to protect everything.
text_block_list.orig_text:
──けど、
おかげで記憶をもってやり直せた。
全部を守ろうと、
みんなが諦めずに戦い続けてくれたおかげだぜ。

text_block_list.name: Subaru
text_block_list.text: I don't know about this white whale or whatever, but I won't let it get in the way of my summer vacation with Emilia-tan!
text_block_list.orig_text:
シロクジラだか何だか知らねぇけど、
エミリアたんとのサマーバケーションを邪魔されてたまるかよ──！

text_block_list.name: Subaru
text_block_list.text: White Whale, this time is different from "Before". This time, we...
text_block_list.orig_text:
前とは違うぜ、
シロクジラ。
今度の俺たちには──

text_block_list.name: Subaru
text_block_list.text: ...We have our bonds!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──絆がある！

text_block_list.name: White whale
text_block_list.text: ...GUOOOH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Small monsters
text_block_list.text: ...GUOOOH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Emilia
text_block_list.text: We have to rescue the people whose memories have been stolen...!
text_block_list.orig_text: 記憶を奪われた人たちを助けないと……！

text_block_list.name: Pecorine
text_block_list.text: Emilia! Don't! The white whale's about to attack...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
エミリアちゃん！　
だめですっ、
シロクジラの攻撃が……！

text_block_list.name: White whale
text_block_list.text: ...GUOOOH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Emilia
text_block_list.text: I'll absolutely... protect you! ...Kyaaa!?
text_block_list.orig_text:
絶対、
守る──
きゃあっ……！？

text_block_list.name: Beachgoers
text_block_list.text: ...Ogya...
text_block_list.orig_text: ……おぎゃ……

text_block_list.name: Emilia
text_block_list.text: Everyone... are you okay...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
みんな、
無事……？

text_block_list.name: Puck
text_block_list.text: Lia! How reckless of you...! You cursed whales... don't think you'll be able to leave this place alive!
text_block_list.orig_text:
リア！　
なんて無茶を……！
お前たち、
生きてこの場を去ることができると思うなよ──！

text_block_list.name: Rem
text_block_list.text: ...Nee-sama! Rem will be supporting Lady Emilia!
text_block_list.orig_text:
──姉様！　
レムはエミリア様の援護に！

text_block_list.name: Ram
text_block_list.text: I'll leave that to you, Rem. Ram and the others will handle the white whales here...! If they break through here, the equilibrium that we just barely managed to maintain will crumble.
text_block_list.orig_text:
任せたわよ、
レム。
こちらのシロクジラはラムたちで……！
ここを破られると、
ギリギリで保っていた均衡が崩れるわ。

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: How irritating...! I can't say I have any time to spare either, but...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
歯がゆいわね……！
こっちも余裕があるとはとても言えないけど……！

text_block_list.name: Kokkoro
text_block_list.text: If only there was some way to change the tide of battle...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
何か、
戦況を変えるきっかけがあれば……！

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: There's no way something that convenient c-...
text_block_list.orig_text: そんなのあるわけ──

text_block_list.name: Pecorine Emilia
text_block_list.text: Please don't give up!  You mustn't give up!
text_block_list.orig_name: ペコリーヌ・エミリア
text_block_list.orig_text:
「諦めないでください！」
「諦めちゃダメ！」

text_block_list.name: ペコリーヌ
text_block_list.text:
こういう時、
{0}くんは……！
text_block_list.orig_text:
こういう時、
{0}くんは……！

text_block_list.name: Emilia
text_block_list.text: At times like this, Subaru...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
こういう時、
スバルは……！

text_block_list.name: Pecorine
text_block_list.text: Always, absolutely...!
text_block_list.orig_text: 絶対に──！

text_block_list.name: Emilia
text_block_list.text: Wouldn't give up...!
text_block_list.orig_text: 諦めない──！

text_block_list.name: Pecorine Emilia
text_block_list.text: As long as you don't give up, there's always hope!
text_block_list.orig_name: ペコリーヌ・エミリア
text_block_list.orig_text:
諦めない限り、
希望はある！

text_block_list.text: Yes, you can say that AGAIN!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ええ──
その通りね！

text_block_list.name: White whale
text_block_list.text: Gyaoooooo!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──ギャオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Emilia
text_block_list.text: That attack just now...!
text_block_list.orig_text: 今の攻撃は……！

text_block_list.name: Saren
text_block_list.text: Looks like things are getting out of hand over here. It's summer, and you guys are all facing such trouble!
text_block_list.orig_text:
なんだか
とんでもないことになってるみたいじゃないの。
せっかくの夏だっていうのに、
あんたたちも災難ね。

text_block_list.name: Rem
text_block_list.text: Lady Saren, are you here to save Rem and the others...?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
サレン様、
レムたちを助けに……！？

text_block_list.name: Saren
text_block_list.text: It's not just me.
text_block_list.orig_text: あたしだけじゃないわ。

text_block_list.name: Kyoka
text_block_list.text: E-EEEEEIIIIII! COSMO BLUE FLASH!
text_block_list.orig_text:
え、
ええーいっ！
コスモブルーフラーッシュ！

text_block_list.name: White whale
text_block_list.text: Gyaoooooo!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──ギャオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Kyoka
text_block_list.text: I-I did it! That was a clean victory!
text_block_list.orig_text:
や、
やったぁ！
ちゃんと当たりました！

text_block_list.name: Emilia
text_block_list.text: Kyouka! Amazing! Not only is she reliable, she can also use some pretty amazing magic.
text_block_list.orig_text:
キョウカちゃん！　
すごい！
しっかりしてるだけじゃなくて、
魔法も使えるのね。

text_block_list.name: Saren
text_block_list.text: Well done over there, Kyouka. If you keep this up, we'll definitely be able to hold one of them down.
text_block_list.orig_text:
よくやったわねキョウカちゃん。
このままあたしたちで
確実に一頭、
抑え込むわよ。

text_block_list.name: Rem
text_block_list.text: Lady Saren and Lady Kyouka are suppressing the white whales together...! But there are still the small monsters to worry of...
text_block_list.orig_text:
サレン様とキョウカ様が
シロクジラを抑えてくれています……！
ですがまだ、
小型の魔物が……

text_block_list.name: Neneka
text_block_list.text: In other words, what you need are numbers right now. Well then, let me even your odds at once... Mirror Mirror
text_block_list.orig_text:
つまり、
必要なのは頭数ですか。
では、
手早く揃えるとしましょう──
ミラーミラー

text_block_list.name: Small monsters
text_block_list.text: Gyaoooooo!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──ギャオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Ram
text_block_list.text: Illusion magic... But not, I can sense a real presence coming from all of them. Splitting yourself into multiple parts and attacking monsters at the same time, it seems being a child is no reason to underestimate someone here.
text_block_list.orig_text:
幻覚の魔法……
ではなく、
全員から本物の気配を感じるわ。
自身を複数に分けて魔物を同時に攻撃するなんて、
子どもだからといって侮れないわね。

text_block_list.name: Neneka
text_block_list.text: ...I'm not the same age as Kyouka. Anyway, I'll be the one to take care of the small fry here. I'll leave it to you to deal with the people who were unable to escape.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……私はキョウカさんと同年代ではありません。
とにかく、
雑魚の処理はこちらで引き受けましょう。
逃げ遅れた人々の対応は
お任せしますよ。

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: Okay, everyone~ Come over to sensei and the others here... Ranpha-chan, follow my lead.
text_block_list.orig_text:
は～い
みんな～♪
先生たちの所においで～♪
ほら、
ランファちゃんも一緒に。

text_block_list.name: Ranpha
text_block_list.text: I too want to learn more from your motherhood vibe, Misato-san... This way everyone... Come here...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
わたしも、
ミサトさんの
母性を、
学ばないと……
こっち、
よ……
おいで……？

text_block_list.name: Beachgoers
text_block_list.text: Babuu♪
text_block_list.orig_text: ばぶー♪

text_block_list.name: Emilia
text_block_list.text: Amazing... The people who have reverted to babies are all heading to their direction, almost like they were drawn in!
text_block_list.orig_text:
すごい……
赤ちゃんみたいになっちゃった人たちが、
まるで吸い込まれるみたいに集まっていくわ。

text_block_list.name: Rem
text_block_list.text: Lady Misato and Lady Ranpha's motherly natures are truly fearsome...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ミサト様とランファ様の母性、
鬼がかっています……！

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: Everyone, as you can see your teacher and everyone else is cheering you on... Do your best not to get hurt♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
みんな、
先生たちが応援してるからね。
怪我しないように
頑張って♪

text_block_list.name: Ranpha
text_block_list.text: Come here, come here...♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
おいで、
おいで……♪

text_block_list.name: Pecorine
text_block_list.text: Thanks to everyone's help, it seems this war situation has stabilized! How crazy is that☆
text_block_list.orig_text:
みんなのおかげで
戦況が安定しました！
やばいですね☆

text_block_list.name: Emilia
text_block_list.text: To think that you'd all be here! Thank you so much! But why?
text_block_list.orig_text:
みんな、
来てくれたのね！　
すごーくありがとう！
でも、
どうして？

text_block_list.name: Saren
text_block_list.text: If you're asking why I came here, the answer is the same for everyone. “He” told me to head here. He seemed really desperate, but I guess this is why.
text_block_list.orig_text:
どうしてここに来たかって質問なら、
答えはみんな同じよ。
『あいつ』に
ここに向かえって言われたの。
凄い必死だったけど、
こういうことだったのね。

text_block_list.name: Kyoka
text_block_list.text: Um, I don't think it's right to suddenly kneel down in front of a child you never met before... but I do know a certain person like that. ...So I instinctively have to help them.
text_block_list.orig_text:
その、
いきなり子ども相手に土下座するのはどうかと思いますけど……
そういう人はよく知っていますし。
……助けてあげなきゃって。

text_block_list.name: Neneka
text_block_list.text: I had no intention of listening to what that obviously suspicious man had to say, but he was so annoying that I had no choice.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あからさまに怪しい男の言うことなど
聞くつもりはありませんでしたが、
あまりにも鬱陶しくまとわりついてくるので、
仕方がなく。

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: I had never seen him before, but he sure was doing his best, so I had to support his request♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
見たことのない男の子だったけど、
一生懸命だったから、
応援しなくちゃいけないわよね♪

text_block_list.name: ランファ
text_block_list.text:
{0}くんを
助けてくれ
って。
真剣な、
声
だった……
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}くんを
助けてくれ
って。
真剣な、
声
だった……

text_block_list.name: Emilia
text_block_list.text: I see... So Subaru... really was doing his best.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そっか……
スバル、
やっぱり頑張ってくれてたんだ。

text_block_list.name: Rem
text_block_list.text: That’s Subaru-kun for you. Rem admires him for once more predicting this situation ahead of time and acting first.
text_block_list.orig_text:
さすがはスバルくんです。
状況を予測しての先回り、
レムは感服しました。

text_block_list.name: Ram
text_block_list.text: It seems that whole thing about his sunscreen was a lie after all. He'll have to pay for deceiving Ram and the others later.
text_block_list.orig_text:
やっぱり日焼け止めなんて戯れ言は嘘だったようね。
あとでラムたちを騙した報いは受けてもらうわ。

text_block_list.name: Puck
text_block_list.text: Once again Subaru is trying to act and look cool.
text_block_list.orig_text:
スバルにしちゃ、
カッコつけすぎだよね。

text_block_list.name: Emilia
text_block_list.text: So, do you know where Subaru is now?
text_block_list.orig_text:
それで、
スバルは今どこにいるの？

text_block_list.name: Saren
text_block_list.text: If you're looking for him, he's over there.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あいつなら、
あそこよ。

text_block_list.name: Small Monster
text_block_list.text: ...GUOOOH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Subaru
text_block_list.text: ...Whoa, that was close!
text_block_list.orig_text:
──うぉっ、
あっぶね！

text_block_list.name: Pecorine
text_block_list.text: Could he be trying to act as a decoy again...!?
text_block_list.orig_text: もしかしてまた自分を囮に……！？

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: What the hell is he doing...!? What if he gets surrounded again...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
何やってんのよあいつ……！
また囲まれたらどうすんのよ……！？

text_block_list.name: Kokkoro
text_block_list.text: No, Lady Kyaru, please take a closer look. Lord Subaru is keeping a close eye on the distance between himself and the enemy. He will then draw the flow of monsters to him and act as a decoy.
text_block_list.orig_text:
いえ、
キャルさま、
よくご覧ください。
スバルさまは
敵との距離をしっかりと見ておられます。
そして
魔物の流れを引き寄せ、
囮としての役割を果たしておいでです。

text_block_list.name: Rem
text_block_list.text: Subaru-kun's being amazing again! But isn't he moving a little strangely? He looks like he's looking for something...
text_block_list.orig_text:
さすがはスバルくんです！
ですが──
少し動きが変ではないでしょうか？
何かを探しているような……

text_block_list.name: Subaru
text_block_list.text: This is not it either...! Who is it? Who has it...?! It can't have been digested yet!
text_block_list.orig_text:
こいつは違うっ……！
どいつだっ？　
どいつが持ってる……！？
まだ消化されてはないはずだ！

text_block_list.name: Subaru
text_block_list.text: From the start, I'm the sole cause for all of this. I ran out on my own, and he covered for me, and then...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
元はと言えば、
俺が原因なんだ。
俺が勝手に飛び出したのを、
あいつがかばって、
それで……！

text_block_list.name: Subaru
text_block_list.text: If it was him, it would've been miles easier for him to gather people here. He wouldn't have had to beg or prostrate himself like I did, he could have created this situation naturally...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あいつだったらもっと、
仲間を集めるのも簡単だったはずだ。
俺みたいに頼み込んだり
土下座したりしなくたって、
この状況を作り出せたんだ……！

text_block_list.name: Subaru
text_block_list.text: YOU, the one who has woven together all those bonds, it is you who I need!
text_block_list.orig_text:
これだけの絆を紡いできたお前が、
必要なんだ！

text_block_list.name: Subaru
text_block_list.text: That one looks just like the one who had my memories...! I’ve finally found you!
text_block_list.orig_text:
こいつは、
俺の記憶を持っていたやつと同じ……！
とうとう見つけたぜ！

text_block_list.name: Subaru
text_block_list.text: PUCK, ITS THIS ONE! DESTROY IT!
text_block_list.orig_text:
パック、
こいつだ！
こいつをやってくれ！

text_block_list.name: Puck
text_block_list.text: I don't really get it, but I won't think about it. Eiii!
text_block_list.orig_text:
よくわかんないけど、
お安いご用さ。
えい！

text_block_list.name: Subaru
text_block_list.text: The final answer is YOU... BRO!
text_block_list.orig_text:
最後の鍵はお前だ、
兄弟！

text_block_list.name: スバル
text_block_list.text:
{0}の記憶を、
返しやがれ──！
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}の記憶を、
返しやがれ──！

text_block_list.name: Small Monster
text_block_list.text: Gyaoooooo!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──ギャオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Subaru
text_block_list.text: ...! Do you remember who I am? Your memories...
text_block_list.orig_text:
っ……！
俺が分かるかっ？　
記憶が……

text_block_list.name: Subaru
text_block_list.text: You're back to normal, right?!
text_block_list.orig_text: 戻ってきたんだな！？

text_block_list.name: Subaru
text_block_list.text: ...I see... Ah, thank goodness.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……そう、
か……
あぁ、
よかった。

text_block_list.name: White whale
text_block_list.text: ...GUOOOH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: スバル
text_block_list.text:
んで、
戻ってきて速攻で悪いんだけど、
{0}の力、
借りてもいいか？
text_block_list.orig_text:
んで、
戻ってきて速攻で悪いんだけど、
{0}の力、
借りてもいいか？

text_block_list.name: Subaru
text_block_list.text: The white whale... we have to drop it dead. With everyone's help. That'll solve everything.
text_block_list.orig_text:
シロクジラ……
あのデカブツを落とす。
みんなの力でな。
それで、
全部解決だ。

text_block_list.name: Subaru
text_block_list.text: YEAH!
text_block_list.orig_text: おうよ！

text_block_list.name: Subaru
text_block_list.text: ...Wait, I’m glad we’ve made up our mind, but which white whale should we aim for? Usually one of those should be the main body or something...
text_block_list.orig_text:
……って、
覚悟決めたのはいいが、
どのシロクジラを狙えばいいんだ？
こういうのって、
どれかが本体、
みたいなヤツだと思うんだけど……

text_block_list.text: ...Hmm, it seems like the "real one" is really obsessed with that boy. I guess the traits it inherited from him are showing through... How interesting.
text_block_list.orig_text:
──ふむ、
どうやら『本物』は
よっぽどあの少年に夢中みたいだね。
受け継いだ性質が色濃く表われているのか……
面白いな。

text_block_list.name: Subaru
text_block_list.text: ...!? What was that... voice just now...? Something about how "real one" is infatuated with someone or something...
text_block_list.orig_text:
っ！？
なんだ、
今の……
声……？
『本物』が誰かに夢中だとかなんとか……

text_block_list.name: White whale
text_block_list.text: ...GUOOOH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Subaru
text_block_list.text: ...! That white whale... It's looking straight at me...! It's just like that monster who was drawn by my stench...
text_block_list.orig_text:
っ……！
あのシロクジラ……
真っ直ぐ俺を見てやがる……！
まるで、
俺の臭いに引き寄せられる魔獣みたいに……

text_block_list.name: Subaru
text_block_list.text: Ah... Sorry for making you worry. It's all right. More importantly, I have an idea of which one's the main body. I can't explain it in detail, but...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ああ……
すまねぇ、
心配させちまって。
大丈夫だ。
それより、本体の目星はついた。
詳しくは説明できないんだけどよ……

text_block_list.name: Subaru
text_block_list.text: Would you still believe in me?
text_block_list.orig_text: 俺を信じてくれるか？

text_block_list.name: Subaru
text_block_list.text: ...Heheh! I knew you'd say that!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……へへっ！
そう言ってくれると思ってたぜ！

text_block_list.name: Subaru
text_block_list.text: Did we do it?! Ah, that was close! I almost set off an ominous flag myself!
text_block_list.orig_text:
やったか！？
ってあっぶね！　
自分から不吉なフラグ立てるところだった！

text_block_list.name: Subaru
text_block_list.text: But it's safe, isn't it!? It won't come back to life, right...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
セーフ
だよ
な！？
今ので復活したりしない、
よな……？

text_block_list.name: Subaru
text_block_list.text: All right! Haha... Sorry for bothering you again with this.
text_block_list.orig_text:
よっし！
はは……
また世話かけちまったな。

text_block_list.name: Subaru
text_block_list.text: Yeah, that's right. That's the kind of guy you've always been.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ああ、
そうだったな。
そういうやつだったよな。

text_block_list.name: Subaru
text_block_list.text: Thanks you, brother.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ありがとな、
兄弟。

text_block_list.name: Emilia
text_block_list.text: ...Subaru!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──スバルー！

text_block_list.name: ペコリーヌ
text_block_list.text:
おーいっ！　
{0}くーん！
text_block_list.orig_text:
おーいっ！　
{0}くーん！

text_block_list.name: Subaru
text_block_list.text: Now then, let's go, bro. We took a bit of a detour, but it looks like we can finally start our otherworldly summer vacation.
text_block_list.orig_text:
さて、
行こうぜ兄弟。
ちっと遠回りしちまったが、
ようやく異世界サマーバケーションが始められそうだ。

text_block_list.name: Subaru
text_block_list.text: Now that we have more friends joining us, let's all have a blast!
text_block_list.orig_text:
仲間も増えたことだし、
みんなで盛大に
盛り上がっとこうぜ！

text_block_list.name: ナレーション
text_block_list.text:
スバルと{0}は拳を軽く合わせ、
駆けつけてくる少女たちの輪に加わるのであった。
text_block_list.orig_text:
スバルと{0}は拳を軽く合わせ、
駆けつけてくる少女たちの輪に加わるのであった。
